rules.name: marks the first entry as the current location before any heading is scrolled to the top
rules.note: The page holds, after the component, a heading for each entry whose id is the entry's anchor (setup, fonts, themes), in the entries' order, each followed by enough content that the page can scroll it to the top. The headings may reach the page after the component mounts. A heading is reached once its top passes a reading line in the upper part of the scrolling area; where that line lies is the framework version's choice, so no rule places a heading between the top and the line.
